Soojin / Marcus — reviewed Aurora's files. Proposed accounting approach below (high level) — attached a one-page journal proposal with suggested lines and example amounts. Link to working draft: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExampleJournalProposal (see JIRA-FIN-2891).

Proposed steps (recommended):
1) Move the receipt in the US entity to Suspense (GL 2100) so cash remains matched but revenue is not recognized against the wrong legal entity.
   - Journal: Debit Cash (1100) / Credit Revenue US (4000) reversed -> instead: Credit Suspense (2100) for the amount currently posted.
2) Post a reapplication in EMEA: Debit Suspense (2100) / Credit Revenue EMEA (4100) with VAT code VAT20-EMEA where applicable.
3) Record VAT delta: if Aurora issues a credit note for VAT difference, post VAT adjustment to VAT Payable (2200) and contra Revenue if necessary.
4) FX & AR aging: run FX reval after reapplication period close; tag the invoices so AR aging follows the original invoice dates.

Journal detail (example numbers using gross GBP 182,460):
- Reverse original US receipt (to suspense): DR Revenue US (4000) 182,460 / CR Suspense (2100) 182,460 — (this clears revenue in US P&L)
- Reapply to EMEA: DR Suspense (2100) 182,460 / CR Revenue EMEA (4100) 151,950; CR VAT Payable (2200) 30,510 (VAT at 20%)
- If Aurora issues VAT credit note (30,510): DR VAT Payable (2200) 30,510 / CR Other Income or Contra Revenue per tax guidance.

Timing: we can do the reverse + reapply in the current period if Aurora provides the corrected remittance and bank confirmation by EOD Friday (2028-10-05). If not, we suggest leaving in suspense and performing the adjustments in the next close cycle.

Note: we will need to tag the internal reclassification with the Aurora payment reference and attach the AP remittance for audit.

Attachement: journal_proposal.xlsx (1 sheet — sample entries)
